name: openalex-research
description: Search and analyze 480M+ scholarly works in OpenAlex from Cursor: papers, citations, authors, institutions, venues, and research trends, via the open-source openalex-research-mcp server.

OPENALEX_API_KEY.title: OpenAlex API key
OPENALEX_API_KEY.description: Free key from https://openalex.org/settings/api. Since Feb 2026 OpenAlex expects a key for anything beyond light demo use ($1/day free usage).

OPENALEX_EMAIL.title: Contact email (optional)
OPENALEX_EMAIL.description: Optional contact email sent in the User-Agent header. The legacy polite-pool mailto parameter is ignored by OpenAlex since Feb 2026.
